## Minecraft 1.21.7 mapped build — known printer packet-loss failure

`litematica-printer-1.1.3+1.21.7.jar` — Fabric / Java 21.

**The unchanged-upstream Printer 1.1.3 combination failed the strict 15% bidirectional-loss test with Servux hand confirmation enabled: 2 wrong server blocks.** Material totals remained conserved and the direct API did not remain busy. This failed check remains a known limitation; it is not counted as a passing acceptance result. The experimental prediction change is not included.

Ordinary production survival clients, genuine v3/v4 and vanilla/Fabric TCP clients, companion unit/server cases and both released bedrock miners passed. The source preserves upstream placement behavior. Further ghost-support investigation is deferred.

Source: [7bb1ac0](https://github.com/water2004/litematica-printer/tree/7bb1ac0f400c3a34310c5ad7afffc7ef411c6491). [Compilation and applicable CI checks](https://github.com/water2004/litematica-printer/actions/runs/39731945459).
